Want to have a whole group of AI staff like xAI's Grok Bot, but don't want to be bound by subscription and cloud? 
 Recently, GitHub's open-source gem OpenMausBot has directly made a local-first open-source alternative to the closed-source Grok Bot, Meta Muse, and OpenAI dots. 
 Its interface is like Telegram or Slack, but every contact on the side bar is a real independent AI Agent: 
 🧠 Self-select brain: You can ask Agent A to write a query to Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Agent B to check gossip on Grok, and Agent C to access the CLI or existing account on your device, without having to buy an expensive forwarding API. 
 🖥️ Each Bot has its own computer: Open the Computer panel, each Agent has its own virtual machine or cloud desktop, and it also supports Live screen preview, watching it quietly browsing the web behind the scenes. 
 🛡️ It will notify you before making a decision: When deleting files or executing high-risk instructions, the chat room will directly pop up the "Allow / Refuse" card, always in your control. 
 It can even directly make voice calls to your AI staff, while you take a walk and ask it to report which tasks were completed last night.

A single person running a complete game studio is no longer a sci-fi movie.

Claude-Code-Game-Studios 
Directly turns a single terminal into an entire game company.

How painful was it to use AI to make games before? 
Open a dialogue box, ask the AI to write code, no planning, no framework review, and after writing, it's either illogical fighting or thousands of lines of Italian pasta code. 
This project directly packages 49 professional AI agents and 74 Slash instructions, strictly simulating the organizational hierarchy of a game company: 
👑 Tier 1 General Manager (Opus): Creative Director, Technical Director, Producer responsible for overseeing project vision and framework 
📋 Tier 2 Department Manager (Sonnet): Main Program, Art Director, Value Planning, QA Manager assigns tasks to components 
🛠️ Tier 3 Professional Expert: Combat Program, Level Design, Economic Values, Sound Effects, and even specialized Godot / Unity / UE5 engine-tuned Agents
The worst part is that it has built-in 15 Git verification hooks and 14 code formatting rules - as long as your code has Hardcode numbers, lacks QA screenshot verification, or breaks the architecture, the submission will be directly blocked and rejected. You're not writing a Prompt, you're signing off on the Studio Head's early meeting.

Who can refuse to have their author's face be pulled like a candy by just entering their personal website? 😂 Recently, I found a super toxic and free interactive Hero component on Scrolltide: Otis. The homepage of traditional works is mostly just a blank page with a big profile picture and self-introduction. This one directly uses WebGL to turn the character designer's face into a "highly flexible modeling clay": 🤏 using a mouse to grab his face. The entire face can be infinitely stretched and twisted like a noodle. The best part is that it's written in React + Vite + WebGL, and the packaging is done. It supports directly copying prompts and sending them to Cursor / Claude Code or MCP. In just a few seconds, you can insert this toxic interaction into your portfolio or personal website. I've put the prompt in the comments.

# Otis — Stretchable-Face Portfolio Hero (1/7)

"Otis Pell — character designer" is a one-screen portfolio hero where you can grab the designer's cartoon face and pull it like taffy. A giant headline, "HEY, I'M OTIS", spans full width with a mustard stroke across the name. Under it, a cobalt disc holds a 3D-cartoon bust of Otis — copper quiff, freckles, mustard turtleneck — whose hair breaks out over the top of the disc and headline.

# Otis — Stretchable-Face Portfolio Hero (2/7)

Grab anywhere on him and skin stretches under pointer into a tapering tube; expression changes with grab spot (hair/ears: "OW"; cheeks: "pinched"; elsewhere: grimace). Release snaps back with rubbery wobble into a random face. A quick tap startles him and jiggles head. Up to four fingers pull at once. Longer stretch flushes cheeks/nose then face, while "Patience" bar drains to red beside "Current mood".

# Otis — Stretchable-Face Portfolio Hero (3/7)

At zero patience, releasing leaves him "seeing stars". Idle for 5s: eyes follow cursor, hovering nose turns him cross-eyed. A handwritten "pull my face" arrow points until first pull; ring cursor tightens on hold.
Surroundings: bio ("I make faces for a living."), mood meter, Sunday subscribe pill ("You're in. He's pulling a face about it."), header avatar, and "As seen in" strip of 6 custom wordmarks.

Claude Code 開始拒絕幫你複製遊戲了。
​
10/27 有開發者發現 Claude Code 多了一條規則，Anthropic 也出面證實：在 Opus 5.5 的 Claude Code 加了兩句話，避免它重做別人的遊戲，因為拿 Claude 侵權違反使用政策。
​
規則很簡單：
◼ 可以 · 原創遊戲、某個類型的遊戲、用自己設計和素材做的遊戲
◼ 不行 · 重做某款已存在的遊戲，就算改名、說是原創也不行
​
麻煩的是誤殺。有用戶說分析 Windows 當機紀錄、清電視垃圾軟體也被拒，接案替客戶做桌上戰棋數位版的公司也被擋，客服回覆「沒有例外」。Anthropic 說會繼續調整。
​
我覺得這條規則看的是「你怎麼說」，不是「你要做什麼」。
真心想抄的人換個說法就過了，被擋的反而是講話直白的正常開發者。

ChatGPT 的額度算法要改了。
​
12 月起，Plus、Pro、Business 方案的 ChatGPT 和 Codex 會共用同一個額度，而且改用 token 計算。
選的模型越進階、任務越複雜，扣得越多。
​
簡單說：
◼ 只用 Instant 聊天、查資料 · 不扣額度，幾乎沒差
◼ 常開進階模型、用 Work 做事 · 開始要算
◼ ChatGPT 和 Codex 都重度用 · 最可能撞牆
​
官方說大多數人等額度重置的頻率不會比現在多，但沒公布每個方案到底有多少 token。
​
我覺得最大的差別是：以前額度分開，不用想「這題值不值得開進階模型」。
以後每開一次，都是在跟自己的 Codex 搶額度。
​
AI 訂閱正在從「分格吃到飽」，變成「一個錢包，用多少算多少」。
會分配模型的人，月中才不會卡關。
